description: This file defines a PHP trait named DecoratorTrait within the OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator namespace. The trait provides methods for managing a decorator object, including lazy instantiation based on the class name derived from the host class.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the decorator object, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getDecoratorClassName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the class name for the decorator based on the host class name.
